newsitem.title: DENMARK: Salomon recommends Danish regional bank shares.
newsitem.headline: Salomon recommends Danish regional bank shares.

text.p: Salomon Brothers advised investors to buy Norwegian and Danish regional bank stock and reduce holdings in Swedish bank paper in a report received by Reuters on Monday.
"Investors are advised to begin reducing weightings in Sweden and to further shift their attention to the Norwegian banks and -- for smaller funds -- to the Danish regional banks," Salomon said.
"The major caveat about Denmark is limited liquidity in the smaller banks," Salomon added.
It cited reports of expected sharp falls in Swedish banks' earnings per share (EPS) in 1997.
Danish regional banks have been reporting relatively better 1996 profits and core earnings than the four big national banks.
